The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of ARPITHA.M..
The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused married CW-1 on 01-09-2021.
At the time of marriage, the accused have demanded and taken gold chain and gold ring to accused and gold necklace, gold ring, gold earrings to CW-1 as dowry from complainant and her family.

After the marriage, the accused have subjected CW-1 mental and physical cruelty by coming to house under the influence of alcohol and used to abuse CW-1 in filthy language, assault CW-1, quarreled with CW-1 for petty matters,harassed CW-1 to get additional dowry of Rs.5 Lakhs from her parents to construct the home, when a male child was born the accused have harassed CW-1 and her parents to organize naming ceremony of the child in a function hall.
On 12- 03-2024 the accused have sent CW-1 out of the house to get Rs.Five lakhs from her parents and thus subjected CW-1 to physical and mental cruelty.
Based on the said information, a case  3  C.C.No.37727/2024 in Cr.No.100/2024 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.I. Basavanagudi Women south P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.

sentences.text: 3  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information  5  C.C.No.37727/2024 statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.
Ex . P.3
is further statement.
10. CW-1 was examined as PW-1 Smt.Arpitha.M..

She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 01-09-2021 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and never abused, assaulted her.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.

PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1. PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.

sentences.text: On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.

In view of the material witness, turning hostile,
and in the absence of evidence of material witness, the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
12. POINT No.2:-

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused is acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A, 504,323 of IPC. & Sec. 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bonds of accused shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
